read: There are a lot of foods we can eat: chicken, broccoli, rice, cookies, and more.
It gives us energy so we can run, jump, and study.
But some foods are healthier than others.
Your body needs good quality foods every day to grow and play.
Look at the Healthy Eating Guide to learn how to eat smart and grow up healthy.
Fruits and vegetables, like bananas and tomatoes, give us all the vitamins and minerals we need.
Eat fruits and vegetables every day.
Yellow Section: Potatoes, Bread, Rice, Pasta
These foods give us energy for our brain and our body.
Eat whole grains to add fiber and to keep your tummy happy.
Eat one serving at every meal.

quiz: Food gives us energy to run, jump, and study.
Which section has fruits and vegetables?
The green section has fruits and vegetables.
What do fruits and vegetables give us?
They give us vitamins and minerals.
When should we eat fruit and vegetables?
Eat fruits and vegetables every day.
Which word has the long o sound?

Which word has the long o sound?
Rose has the long o sound, spelled o–e.
Which word has the long o sound?
Home has the long o sound.
Choose ALL the long o words: Look at that big boat.
Boat has the long o sound.
She is wearing a red bow in her hair. Find the long o word.
Bow has the long o sound, spelled ow.
After school, we go home. Find the long o words.
Go and home have the long o sound. School has the oo sound.
I’m wearing my coat because it’s very cold. Find the long o words.
Coat and cold have the long o sound.
